Re-declared by the executing seat from **this card's own delivered slice** of PR #16924, not copied from the governing card. That slice corrects the `action` entry to `objectName`, `confirmText` and `target`, and replaces a required-table row advertising a `"button"` action type that is not a member of `ActionType` (`['script','url','modal','flow','api','form']`). ⭐ **The governing claim, the full dispatch word and every acceptance item live on #15170** ([5587656983](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/15170#issuecomment-5587656983)). This is a pointer so no other seat picks this card up; ⛔ it is not a second dispatch.

Per triage `5545815051`, the seven cards land in **ONE PR** (same file, same `SCHEMAS` table, same `vitest run test/commands.test.ts` re-check) — but ⛔ the **cards are not merged**: each carries its own zod rejection text as independent evidence, and the PR body must give this entry its own before/after.

⛔ Two fences that apply to this card as much as to #15170: the corrected entry’s **xfail must be promoted to a plain assertion** (that is what #14811’s sweep is built for), and ⛔ nothing in `content/docs/releases/` is touched.
